description: Renovate owns every dependency: the versions.env pins, go.mod/go.sum and the GitHub Actions in .github. 3 days Supply-chain cooldown for dependencies.

customManagers.description: Pins in versions.env annotated with a `# renovate:` comment; a following *_DIGEST line is bumped with the version

packageRules.description: No publish date reaches Renovate for these: our own Harbor registry has none, and Docker Hub's node tag listing gets rate-limited before the current tag. timestamp-required would hold them back forever, so they take the update without the cooldown
One PR for all Go minor and patch updates (was dependabot's gomod-minor-patch group); majors and the go directive get their own PRs
go.mod replaces go-containerregistry with the knqyf263 fork; bumping the replaced require line changes nothing that gets built, and the fork is moved by hand
One PR for all GitHub Actions updates (was dependabot's github-actions group); the pinned SHAs and their version comments move together
A Trivy patch release is an adapter patch release: release-please parses the squash-merged PR title
prBodyNotes: Re-check `trivy-cve-overrides.txt` against the new tag: `task build:trivy` asserts each audited version on the pristine tag, so a stale entry fails the preview build instead of silently pinning below upstream.

packageRules.description: Anything bigger is an adapter minor release
prBodyNotes: Re-check `trivy-cve-overrides.txt` against the new tag: `task build:trivy` asserts each audited version on the pristine tag, so a stale entry fails the preview build instead of silently pinning below upstream.

packageRules.description: Trivy PRs are fix:/feat:, so pr-title.yml requires a final Release Notes section; prFooter is the last part of the body
packageRules.prFooter:
## Release Notes

The adapter image now ships Trivy {{{newVersion}}}.

packageRules.description: These pins carry a hand-computed *_SHA256_* line that Renovate cannot update
prBodyNotes: Recompute the matching `*_SHA256_*` pin in `versions.env` before merging: Renovate bumps only the version, and the install step fails on the stale checksum.
